scale_evidence.reuse_rationale: Geometry-only sigma/beta come from TRAIN reference residuals and transition spans and do not depend on the emission classifier family, so the historical immutable fit is reused read-only instead of recomputed.

scale_reuse: read-only reuse of the historical TRAIN-only geometry fit; no refitting and no copy
calibration_rule: first eight sorted TRAIN IDs whose numeric ID modulo 10 is 1; unchanged preregistered TRAIN8 set
objective: mean exact-original-ID length-weighted repeated-arc route F1 across the eight TRAIN calibration trips; a failed trip contributes zero
selection_tie_break: predeclared order A, B, C for exactly equal objectives
freeze: Write the phase MatchConfig artifact before student-development ablation; never revise it from those results
search_input_boundary: The search opens TRAIN tracks and TRAIN reference routes only; no student file is read during search and the plan cannot change from student outcomes

historical_comparator.note: Geometry-only all-ten baseline (macro lengthF1 0.9734481048408883, countF1 0.9261891312626117) reused as a historical comparator, not as a new learned model

limitations: Scale evidence is a historical TRAIN-only fit reused read-only; the phase never refits geometry scales.
The phase emission model was fitted on all TRAIN80, so decoder TRAIN8 search is in-sample calibration after classifier fitting, not unseen generalization.
Earlier geometry-only and HistGB student results existed as context, so this is not a fully blind phase; the predeclared search still reads only TRAIN predictions and references.
Student-development10 is not the absent reserved evaluator10.
Pointwise labels are route-derived proxies with a weak GPS-motion direction tie-break, not supplied observation-aligned ground truth.
